messages:
maya: Quick design spike — attaching a compact run-history mock for function-calling sessions. looking for quick takes on copy + accessibility before we ship to staging figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/schema-flow-compact

owen: Nice, I like the condensed rows. One ask: make the schema-version tag a keyboard-focusable chip — important for screen reader users. :eyes:

sara: Copy nit: 'Show structured output' reads a bit heavy. Maybe 'View structured output' or just 'Structured output'? Shorter is easier to scan in a dense list.

maya: Good point on copy — leaning toward 'View structured output'. Also thinking of adding a tiny diff icon that opens an inline schema snapshot instead of a full modal. Thoughts?

tyler: Inline snapshot is good, but keep an explicit 'Open raw JSON' link. Some PMs and SREs always want to paste raw. Maybe hide it behind an overflow menu but accessible via keyboard (shift+f?)

own: +1 for raw JSON link. For the diff icon — ensure color contrast meets AA for both default and selected states. Current mock uses light green on white. Figma has values: #0db06b / #ffffff — we should check contrast.

sara: Also accessibility: when the snapshot opens inline, trap focus on the snapshot region and provide an escape key to close. Screen readers should announce "schema snapshot dialog" even if it's inline.

maya: Good checklist. Another UX thought: run rows show model, duration, and a little function-signature preview. Should the function signature be editable inline (like quick edit) or open the full schema editor? I worry inline editing could lead to accidental changes.

tyler: I'd prefer open the schema editor from an 'Edit' action. Quick inline edits could be allowed only for description/copy fields, not types. Less blast radius.

own: For run history filtering — add a small pill bar: All / Successful / Schema mismatch / Error. 'Schema mismatch' should surface a one-line reason: e.g., "Missing field 'user_id'" so designers and devs see at-a-glance why reruns are needed.

sara: UX copy for mismatch badge: avoid alarmist language. Suggest 'Schema mismatch' -> 'Schema diff' (less scary). And show a severity dot: info/warn/error.

maya: Love the severity idea. We'll map: info=blue, warn=amber, error=red. Owen please run contrast tests.

own: Will do. Also: keyboard shortcut for opening the most recent run's structured output = '.' (dot) — seems handy during demos. Document in keyboard shortcuts page.

tyler: tiny code sample for how we surface structured output in the UI, for engineering to hook into:
```
getRunOutput(runId).then(output => {
  renderStructuredPanel(output.schemaSnapshot, { showRawToggle: true });
});
```

sara: one more: run-history density control. Some folks want a compact list by default, others prefer spacious rows. Add a small density toggle (compact/comfortable) in top-right of the panel. Persist in user prefs.

maya: Agreed. I'll update the figma to include density toggle, inline snapshot, 'View structured output' text, raw JSON overflow action, and severity dot. Will also add the focus-trap behavior notes.

design-bot: Prototype deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/playground/compact-run-history (user: maya) — automated visual tests queued. :robot_face:

own: Visual tests flagged the green contrast issue on hover for the diff icon; filing a quick issue: https://issues.redwood.ai/ISSUE-1427

maya: Thanks — I'll iterate, push a new frame later today. If anyone wants to pair on keyboard interactions, ping me — I can carve out 30m. :calendar:
